correctness.rationale: On full side occupancy the missed area is exactly one half the sum of sine-weighted nearest boundary endpoint-gap products. Disjoint short arcs have joint survival (1-sum(t)/N)^N, giving independent unit exponential limits; side vacancies are exponentially rare. Gap survival <=exp(-t) plus Hölder yields every fixed integer moment. The Laplace/moment formulas are direct integrations, and strict Jensen concavity proves the angular maximizer. The independently constructed convex-hull checker passed 300 exact area identities and seeded simulation corroborations.
